notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::getRangeBounds on a standard one-dimension region and the successful HLAreportServiceInvocation delivered through the standard MIM. The region range query maps to IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause 9.1.2; successful service-report content maps to clauses 11.5 and 11.5.1. Federation setup reuses the existing federation execution API contract. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. Before enabling reports the test sets and commits a valid region range using the adapter dimension's standard upper bound; it then verifies the queried range and all eight standard report parameters, including inherited HLAfederate reporter identity, both supplied handles, returned range bounds, reliable delivery, success/exception state, and serial. It performs no region-based subscription, publication, update, interaction routing, or provider-specific inspection.
